_comment: Packages whose published metadata misstates their licence. Each entry names the licence actually granted by the LICENSE file in the distribution, and why the metadata is wrong. check-licences.py uses the override instead of the metadata; keep this list short and every entry justified.

qrcode.reason: LICENSE in the wheel is the BSD 3-clause text (Copyright 2011 Lincoln Loop) and METADATA says 'License: BSD'; the package also carries a stray 'License :: Other/Proprietary License' classifier, which is a metadata error, not a term.
